subject: Important Update: New Payment Options Available
body: Dear valued customers, we are excited to announce that we have added new payment options to make your shopping experience even more convenient. You can now pay using Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal on our website. We hope this improvement enhances your shopping experience with us. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing to shop with us. Warm regards.
